nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Cream

avis.titre: Works best in tandem with other vitamin C
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream has a strong orange colour and intense orange scent that I enjoyed, it was very refreshing. I found this didn't have much of an effect on my skin over time, I prefer to use the serum from this same product line. This did not irritate my skin at all.
I received it as a sample. Im 64 and I use contouring. After one use over night. Improved skin texture. Tightened up my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It feels great, super moisturizing, doesn't feel tacky or sticky on the face, it smells very citrusy and lightweight. I didn't really see a difference as far as brightness. I suffer feom hyperpigmentation so it didnt really do alot for my skin as far as brightness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As someone with rosacea I cannot rave about this product enough. The first photo shows the before and the product on its cute little spoon. The second photos shows the redness almost gone! Its quality is amazing and worth the price. No breakouts and has helped with the texture of my skin. I will be buying this when I run out. I love it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been wearing this consistently for weeks and I have seen great results! This brightening Vitamin C Cream has sooo many good ingredients. I have a long skincare routine but some nights if I'm tired, if I just put this moisturizer, it helps sooo much. It has made my skin much more hydrated and moisturized. It kinda has a scent of turmeric. It works really well as makeup primer as well! I love how it truly benefits my skin. I would totally buy again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packing of this moisturizer is luxurious and it wells really well under makeup. The product does moisturize really well but it has a scent that lingers and I'm not really a fan of my face moisturizer being scented.

I absolutely love this moisturizer after using it night and day! My face is a little red & this has evened it out somehow! My face is normally sensitive to trying new things & I did not breakout at all from this and I do use it night and day!

avis.titre: Luxurious skincare with visible skin improvement
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a 45 year-old woman, I've come to expect excellence from Sunday, Riley, and their C. E. O. Afterglow moisturizer does not disappoint. It's a high-quality formula that fits perfectly into a mature skin care routine. Thoughtful Design The packaging is beautiful, but I especially love the inclusion of the small spatula. The spatula is a game changer for two reasons: 1. Hygiene: it keeps bacteria from your hands out of the jar. 2. Product Integrity: it prevents the Vitamin C from degrading due to repeat finger contact, ensuring the formula stays potent. Texture and Wear The brands claim of a non-greasy, satin skin finish is 100% accurate. The gel cream texture is incredibly lightweight and absorbs almost instantly. Because it sinks in so quickly without leaving a taxi residue, it provides long lasting moisture that sits beautifully under makeup my foundation looks fresh all day without pilling or sliding. I have very textured skin and while this didn't physically smooth out my skin surface, it worked wonders on my complexion. I noticed significant Aunt brightening and more even skin tone. It has been particularly effective at fading the appearance of my age. Giving me vibrant, healthy skin. If you're looking for a quick absorbing luxurious moisturizer that tackles, hyper pigmentation and provides a perfect canvas for foundation, this is it. It delivers dehydration, invisible radiance, without the weight of traditional

I like this product. The packaging was super luxe and gorgeous. The vitamin c smell and scent of this product is strong and a bit overwhelming, and usually scent doesn't bother me. It's too soon to see any difference.

This product I had high hopes for but it unfortunately was not for me. This cream pills a lot and if you're planning to use it under makeup you should probably look for another product. The fragrance is pretty strong but not off putting.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first experience with Sunday Riley, though my daughter uses these products. I can officially say that I am now a fan as well. This vitamin c moisturizer is lightweight, hydrating, not sticky, and absorbs well. And after a couple of weeks I have seen real results. My mature skin looks smoother and brighter and more alive. Very happy with this product and recommend it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to try out this Sunday Reilly product because I am a fan of their other products. I also struggle with dark marks, hyper pigmentation, and post inflammatory redness from acne so I was excited to try out this vitamin C brightening cream first off. I want to say that these smell is fantastic for a body lotion however, I tried to not use scented products on my face in this product is heavily fragranced. I don't think it necessarily irritated my skin however someone with sensitive skin I was a little worried about it. I also prefer products to be in a pump packaging because I think dipping my finger fingers into the product is not always the most sanitary. I do like its moisturizing properties though.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I want to give this product 5 stars but I'm giving it 4 due to the fragrance. I got used to it the more I used it but it is very strong and when you are putting it on your face, if you are sensitive to strong scents, this might not be for you. But I loved the cream itself. It is bright yellow but once rubbed into your skin does not leave any yellow color or residue. This makes my skin feel so soft. It also allows me to apply my makeup evenly overtop of it. A little goes a long way so I anticipate this container lasting a while. I've been using it for a month now. I have combination dry/oily skin and it has helped with the dry areas without making my face oily. 5 stars for the product itself but the scent is just too overpowering!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can't say enough about this product. I don't enjoy the smell but the product works so well on spots you may want to lighten on your face. It's like a gel and glides on so smooth. I have had multiple Sunday Riley products throughout the last few years. Im a repeat buyer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I can't say enough about this product. I don't enjoy the smell but the product works so well on spots you may want to lighten on your face. It's like a gel and glides on so smooth. I have had multiple Sunday Riley products throughout the last few years. Im a repeat buyer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never had a vitamin c product work how it's supposed too. This product has changed my skin. The packaging is perfection. It's easy to blend it and not sticky, almost moisturizing. My skin is clearer! 10/10

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So I am a HUGE fan of this product. Since receiving it to test, I have already purchased it again. The quality and effectiveness are unmatched. I do feel like it does exactly what it promises, gives you an afterglow like no other. My skin used to feel dull, but not anymore. I love that they give you the little spoon, I don't really use it, but still, I love it!

I'm absolutely loving this moisturizer! The texture is incredibly lightweight and leaves a beautiful, healthy glow without feeling greasy. It absorbs quickly, making it perfect for under makeup. I've noticed my skin looks brighter and more refreshed since I started using it. Plus, the light citrus scent is so uplifting in the morning! No breakouts or sensitivity issues so far.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Impressive, beautiful packaging! Unique moisturizer-marigold yellow with a citrusy, floral fragrance. Feels decadent on the skin-leaving behind a slight glow and smooth finish.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really enjoyed using this product! The consistency really hydrates my face and I have noticed glowiness from the vitamin c. I was a little shocked how orange it was but it doesn't stain the face- the smell is citrusy so keep in mind for those sensitive to scents. The packaging is beautiful and I love that it comes with an applicator

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary from Influester for testing purposes. Sunday Riley is not a new brand for me; I purchased and used their products before. I think this moisturizer is good, but for me, it is too oily, and I am not a fan of an open jar style moisturizer. The texture is silky and bouncy, with no irritation, but I do feel overwhelmed with the scent.

This is a wonderful brightening moisturizer-it has helped my skin a lot. My under eye area have started to seem more alive and refreshed. My sunspots have diminished in color-which I am super excited about. I love the citrus scent and how thick is goes on to make me get a feel for extra hydration. It lasts until the morning when I reapply to start my day. This really has been a game changer for my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this brightening cream. We have already purchased a new bottle in will continue to use it. I received multiple compliments about my glow and shine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was SO excited to try this product! It is so rich and moisturizing! I also loved the applicator with the rounded end to massage into your under eyes area. Nice touch. Keeps the moisturizer clean and use the perfect amount.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin c moisturizer is my favorite that I've tried yet. Especially for acne prone skin I love that it was soothing and didn't break my out. Also smells so fresh. The packaging was super nice and you get a lot of product for the price. I also love that it came with an applicator so I don't have to touch the product .

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream has a very strong but pleasant smell to it and I was worried that it being orange would stain my skin. It is not too thick which I like and feels nice on my skin

avis.titre: It makes the skin a dewy and radiant
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sunday Riley C.E.O afterglow is a lightweight, vitamin C infused moisturizer that gives skin an instant healthy glow. It absorbs quickly, hydrates well, and helps brighten dull complexion over time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This moisturizer is super hydrating. I love the ingredients and how easy it blends into the skin. It is a thick moisturizer so if you don't like that, I wouldn't recommend it. The only thing I don't love is the color and the strong citrus scent. It throws me off a bit but other than that, it's great. I also appreciate the spatula it comes with to pick up the product. It's also very brightening and gives the skin a glowing appearance right after application.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging for the C.E.O afterglow brightening moisturizer is so luxe. The moisturizer itself is a bright yellow hue and it just screams vitamin c. It promises to improve and brighten complexion in just a days and I have noticed a great improvement. It not only has vitamin c but gluten, an amino acid, and sodium hyaluronic bend for hydration. I found that is light gel texture want heavy but packed the hydration. I will continue to use this moving forward.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This moisturizer is amazing. It feels so nice on your skin. It has such a nice soft delightful scent to it. It makes your skin so hydrated so youthful so nice ! I enjoy you can even use it on your neck

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this product / very hydrating and easily absorbs! I have added it to my daily routine. I also love the lemon/citrus scent that is so refreshing. The container also has some weight to it so it feels and appears luxurious.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is fine, I don't love the texture or smell. It would be better suited for summer when I am more oily. I don't see a ton of difference in dark spots but no breakouts either. Plays well under makeup.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Actually love this. First off it smells really good. It leaves the skin looking like glass. I like that it has vitamin c in it, so I can skip the serum. It works well under makeup.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Strong vitamin c scent. Texture doesn't feel greasy and absorbs into the skin nicely. My skin feels moisturized and a little goes a long way so this will last me a while. Love the tool it comes with for sanitary reasons.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A surprisingly bright yellow cream that creates a wonderful glow on the skin is what I would sum this up as. It is a good product and the ingredients are good, this is good for a glow and a skin pick me up.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I C.E.O. Afterglow Brighthening Vitamin C moisturizer has been very amazing. I have seen very great results on my skin. Less dark spots, much more brighter. My face looks much hydrated and glowing. Has a nice consistency great ingredients.

avis.titre: Don't let the color and smell fool ya. It's packed With glow
avis.texte: It's definitely fancy right off the bat. Comes in a nice box with a little cream spatula that's just too cute. The glass jar is definitely a nice touch. Let's get into it. The smell baby...it's is POTENT. wheeew. Knocked me out the first time I opened the jar. Smells very, VERY herbal and almost like honey as well. Maybe even a tiny bit of citrus, but I can't be certain. Definitely herbal though. Then, there's the crazy bright yellow color. It's a bit different but kind of cool too. The consistency is actually amazing. Glides on my face like butter and left the most beautiful glow. I find myself a tad bit sensitive to vitamin c in general, so I just have to be careful to not overdo it. I found that this did not break me out more than normal and didn't cause any irritation upon application. Would I repurchase? No, because of the very high price. But it's definitely a good vitamin c moisturizer if you're looking for one on a higher budget.

i love this moisturizer. no other product makes my skin glow like this one does. i have also noticed that my dark spots and hyperpigmentation have faded and my skin texture is much smoother. this makes my skin look incredible!! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] this product made my skin glow so much is important to vitamin C in your skin because it just makes such a difference. It makes me feel so radiant. Plus I love the application of the product. I would definitely recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] rapidly approaching 40 like me? this is a must. nice smell, didn't irritate my eyes or make me oily. product didn't affect my makeup throughout the day, in fact, I think it helped the way my finishing powder set in my under eyes and helped with creasing. packaging and application is super nice. smooth consistency. hard to tell if it actually brightened my under eye in limited time usage but it didn't hurt to try!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very surprised when I opened to find that the cream was such a bright yellow! The texture is smooth absorbs nicely on my skin with no residue. I feel this product is effective and smells wonderful. Would definitely recommend it to anybody did not make my skin break out, which is great because I have sensitive skin. The little product tool that is provided is also great because I have fingernails and often times creams get stuck under my nail.

There wasn't any irritation and my skin did feel hydrated but I've used other vitamin c moisturizers that are orange but don't make my skin orange.

I'm impressed that Sunday Riley uses ingredients that are proven to give results. I definitely recommend this cream to help fight the signs of premature aging.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a time saver for skincare. The moisturizer comes in a beautiful box and it includes a tiny spoon to avoid using your finger. The moisturizer is smooth and smells citrusy, goes well under makeup and leaves my face looking glowy.
I received this product for review purposes only. So far the product seem to work just have to be consistent. O am not to fond of the smell of the product.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product! This really brightened up my skin and gave me the hydration throughout the day I was looking for! With long term use I saw a visible difference in my skins overall texture and brightness. I looked healthier and had a more even complexion. Definitely on the pricier side but a product that WORKS! Scent is a little strong and the actual color of the product is yellow but blends into the skin like a dream.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Everything about this is luxurious - from the packaging to the product itself. In just over a week my skin genuinely appeared to have a glow to it. I only wish it smelled a little bit better.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This afterglow brightening cream looks and smells expensive! The bright yellow tint kind of scared me at first, but it's extremely hydrating and gives you an instant glow. Can't wait to keep using it and see the overall effects.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I know Sunday Riley makes really good products so I have high hopes for this. I haven't been using it long enough to see any results yet. But, I can say it isn't making me break out, doesn't leave any feeling on my face, and doesn't ball up when applying sunblock or foundation over it. So, it is looking very promising! I like the smell better before applying, it turns into very strong raw floral scent after rubbing in but thankfully that dissipates quickly. I like to use this in the morning after showering before having any amount of sun exposure. Makes me feel better to know I'm fighting free radicals! I look forward to seeing results after long term use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was an interesting moisturizer, I feel like I've had this before, but it's definitely not the same. The yellow color is quite vibrant and I feel like it leaves a little bit of a cast on my very pale skin. I only use this at night, so it didn't impact my make up at all. I do really like the formula, Sunday. Riley has great formulas in my opinion. I was expecting it to smell citrusy, but it's more of a vetiver type of a scent. Overall, it's nice, but won't be a purchase for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product. I really like how soft it made my skin and brightened it. The packaging makes it feel really boujee. I will purchase this product for later use!

avis.titre: My new favorite nightly skincare routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This moisturizer is phenomenal! I am completely blown away by the results and think I have just found my new créme de la créme - literally. I can't remember the last time I used a face moisturizer that made me feel beautiful, like actually visibly more beautiful and radiant. Maybe it's the orange blossom. A similar product sold by a much more expensive brand has orange blossom in it, but CEO Afterglow by Sunday Riley comes at half the price. I knew as soon as I took this jar out of the high-quality packaging box that I was in for a treat. It comes in a vibrant orange and golden ombre jar. And in the lid of that jar is an application spoon, which keeps application clean and germ-free (providing that shows the company truly cares). The moisturizer is cool to the touch and smells incredible - it's bright any joyful and citrusy. It feels so good to apply. This has become my favorite nightly ritual. I apply it just before bed, and the fragrance provides a luxurious nightcap. I wake up every morning with bright, glowing skin!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I got this product in exchange for my honest review. Honestly, I will never spend my money on a moisturizer that is dark yellow in color. Since this product has Vitamin C in it and has a brightening effect, I believe it should be marketed as a turmeric cream which is also yellow in color and has a brightening effect. I've been using it for more than a month and I'm done with half of the jar. I like the earthy smell of the moisturizer. I use it mostly at night and use sunscreen during the day. Overall, a good cream but won't buy it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This one was too heavy for me, it pilled on my skin. It helped lighten dark spots a bit. The scent was strong but didn't last long (thankfully). It smells nice, like oranges and flowers, but would be overwhelming on my face all day.

avis.titre: My skin feels like a million bucks!
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I'm so glad I got to try it. I feel so fancy using this moisturizer. The first thing I noticed when I opened the jar was the vivid yellow orange color. My skin can be somewhat sensitive to Vitamin C moisturizers and creams, so I just used this as my nighttime moisturizer before bed. I really do feel like it gave my skin a vibrancy, a glow. It has a great texture. It soaks into the skin and it doesn't feel sticky. The cream is not too thick or thin. It's just right. The smell reminds me of going outside and picking petals off a yellow dandelion flower. A natural sort of smell. I've really been enjoying using this moisturizer and my skin likes it too. After use, my skin feels clean and bright.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First off this smells so good I can't get over it. I am a citrus girl through and through so that vitamin C smell is amazing. I put it on right after my shower and my skin went from feeling dry to hydrated almost instantly. As a dark circle queen the brightening is a nice plus. The color threw me off at first because it is very yellow but overall it's a 10!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I found this to just be ok, I didn't notice much of a brightening effect over the month I used it. I didn't think it seem to irritate my skin at first, but I took a small break and noticed the little bit of redness I had disappeared. I like the thick gel consistency, although it does leave a yellow tint when first applied. The packaging is luxurious and I like the spatula it came with. Maybe with more time I would have seen a lasting result but in the month I used it I wasn't impressed.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a good product. But I have to say it has a strong fragrance. Not to chemicals but to the orange tree, if you grew up with a orange tree in your house this has the exact same fragrance. It absorbs quickly which is good and I use it every other day in the mornings, remember to always use SPF after this product. It gives my skin a cute glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Actually brightened up my skin. I have sensitive skin so I'm always hesitant to try a vitamin c moisturizer but I had no issues with this one. The scent is a very light citrus and the moisturizer is thick but not greasy. It is obviously a bright orange so it did leave an orange tint on my fair skin but it wasn't too noticeable. I used it consistently for 2 weeks and noticed some spots did lighten and it really leaves a good glow. Makes a great base to wear under makeup or on its own. It absorbs quickly but my skin still feels soft and hydrated all day.

I recently had the chance to try the C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Moisturizer for free in exchange for my honest review, and I was genuinely impressed. The packaging immediately caught my eye. It's sleek, vibrant, and radiates a sunny energy that feels uplifting on my vanity. The texture of the moisturizer is rich yet lightweight, absorbing quickly into the skin without any greasy residue or pore-clogging heaviness. I will say, using too much will rub off in chunks. After application, my skin looks healthy and radiant, giving an instant glow. The formula, packed with vitamin C and other nourishing ingredients, helps brighten and hydrate, which I've noticed with consistent use. A little product goes a long way, which makes it a great value for the quality. Overall, if you're looking for a moisturizer that delivers a luminous finish while supporting long-term skin health, this one definitely lives up to its name.

avis.titre: Glow Goals with a Few Flakes
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received Sunday Riley's C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Cream for free in exchange for my honest feedback. I've been a fan of Sunday Riley for years, so I was genuinely excited to finally try their vitamin C cream-and it did not disappoint. First off, the texture is everything! It's a lightweight gel-cream that feels so refreshing during application, and it absorbs beautifully into my skin. After a few weeks of consistent use, I've definitely noticed my complexion looking brighter and more radiant, which tells me it's doing its job. My skin also feels incredibly hydrated. This vitamin C moisturizer really delivers when it comes to nourishment, and my skin just drinks it up. That said, I haven't reached that perfectly even skin tone just yet, but I'm hopeful that with continued use in the morning and evening, I'll keep seeing improvements. The only downside for me is that it tends to pill, both on my pillow overnight and under makeup-which is why I'm giving it four stars instead of five. Overall-a glow-boosting staple with only a few minor flaws.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the results I have had from using Sunday Riley C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Moisturizer. It has made my skin look healthier and a bit brighter. My skin feels hydrated and soft after using it. It has not caused any irritation or breakouts. It is easy to apply and absorbs into my skin very well. It is comfortable on my skin and does not feel sticky or heavy. It is difficult to find a moisturizer that doesn't make my skin break out so I'm very happy to have the chance to try this one as it has worked great for my skin.

This is a great moisturizer for someone with a bit of dryer skin that needs color correction. It's thick but not sticky and bright orange. Once you apply it the color blends into your skin and it creates this very nice glow. I used it for a bit and didn't see much of a difference so perhaps if I keep using it I'll see more significant results. Only complaint is it's a little too thick for my taste for a day moisturizer and it gives too nice of a glow for it to be only used in the night. It has a orangey herbal scent that I don't mind too much as it goes away. Overall not bad just needs to be used consistently.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This thick yellowy moisturizer instantaneously gives the appearance of soft lighting hitting the high points of my face. It is thick and you need just a few light swipes. It will take almost a year to finish the high quality jar. Worth its price per wear, it's a tiny bit sticky but your skin will drink it up and leave a velvety smooth surface. It has a unique scent, reminiscent of fruit loop cereal. I enjoy applying it before bed or as a day cream.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the packaging! I really liked the consistency of the product it felt thick and luxurious. It does have a strong smell I will say that. It makes your skin look plump and beautiful, it does go on a little thick so I was using it at night. I used it for a couple weeks, but then had a reaction to something in my skincare and cut everything out. So I'm not sure if this was the cause or not.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't think I would actually see results after a week, but you can tell a difference in your skin! It feels so much healthier and my complexion looks better overall. The little applicator that comes with this is so cute, such a fun little touch. But my favorite part? It smells delicious. Why are there so many face creams that don't? Thankful for this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sunday Riley is a brand I've only so far tried samples of. I've heard great things, great reputation! Been using this a few weeks. Upon opening, I looove that it has the Spatula inside. Makes it feel a little glamorous ✨️ My face was much more perplexed when seeing the actual moisturizer. It is...very yellow. Like, neon moon yellow. I did a little search to make sure my product was not contaminated by the ooze in TMNT. Seems legit. It does make your face radiant and glowy. I only used this when I was also wearing foundation that day because that yellow, for me, does leave a hue of it on my face. Could be a head trip for me, but I felt a little yella. But the glow, fantastic. Moisturized? Absolutely. Smell, Bright and Citrusy. Going to keep using and see how it goes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the bright color of this lotion! Really makes me feel like I'm indulging with Vitamin C because of that gorgeous color! Gives my skin a nice glow that isn't too shiny or greasy. Just enough of a lift to make my skin look supple. As I've aged, I've lost elasticity in my face and neck and this has improved my skin. I don't smell or see any added fragrance which is nice. It's a subtle orange peel smell but not strong at all.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is pretty cool. Not only will it cleanse your face, neck and surrounding areas. It brightens and firms the places as well. I also tried it as a primer for my primer. It's really good makes everything so smooth.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the texture, how it moisturizes the skin, it contains a little aroma, smell like citrus. It s very good I love it. Perfect for every day. I recommended it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this cream. I use it morning and night and it has made a big difference for me. I love that this has hardly any scent and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated. I didn't experience any breakouts with this cream which is another plus. There's a little spatula thingy that comes with the cream and it makes applying the cream so much easier. My skin looks healthier and brighter than before.

I was a little scared to try the Sunday Riley Brightening Vitamin C Moisturizer because I have combination skin and it usually gets oily when using some moisturizers. However this moisturizer was not oily or sticky at all and it glides on the skin like butter which makes it easier to massage into the skin. I like to apply the moisturizer at night so it has enough time to absorb to get the best results. It does have a lemon grass earthy scent and once it settles into the skin there's a mild Froot Loops cereal scent that lingers. The packaging is a cute ombré summery orange color and the moisturizer itself is a bright yellow color.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the C.E.O afterglow brightening vitamin C moisturizer and really love how it feels on my skin. It is lightweight, deeply hydrating, and gives my complexion a brighter, healthier glow. It absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or greasy. I have also noticed that a dark spot has started to look lighter since using this product. I would add that it is great for men also, my husband usually has a hard time using mosturizers, but he likes this one for the same reasons I do. Our skin feels energized!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Sunday Riley C.E.O. afterglow brightening vitamin c moisturizer is a rich brightening cream that really seems to work! Each time I have chosen to wear this cream, people have made comments about how healthy my skin looks! I highly suspect there is a correlation! The color is VERY bright yellow which was surprising to me, but it blends well into the skin. The smell was initially somewhat odd as it is very herbal in nature, but I have grown to enjoy it, and the smell goes away once on the skin and is really not noticeable (as someone sensitive to scents). I am very impressed with this cream and would recommend it to others!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] From the days that I've been using this product I've noticed that my skin is brighter and flawless. I like that the texture is creamy and cool to the skin.

avis.titre: Glowy skin... but watch your clothes
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Brightens and hydrates beautifully! This cream leaves my skin glowing with a soft, non greasy finish. It feels lightweight but still moisturizing, and my complexion looks more radiant and even. I also enjoy the light citrus scent. One downside, when I apply it on my neck, it can stains clothes and the marks are hard to remove, so be careful.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sunday Riley C.E.O. Glow really delivers exactly what it promises- radiant, hydrated skin with a healthy lit from within glow. The Vitamin C rich formula feels lightweight but deeply nourishing, and it layers beautifully underneath makeup without feeling greasy. After consistent use my skin lookskin looks smoother, brighter and more even. Perfect for anyone looking for that effortless glow without heavy products. Just love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin C rich hydration cream has done wonders for my skin! After a month of consistent use, I have noticeably brighter skin! My dark spots, sun spots, and hyperpigmentation has seriously improved so drastically! It absorbs so nicely into your skin, it doesn't just sit on top like a lot of moisturizers. I love the dark yellowy/orangey color, it's gorgeous and I know it does wonders for my skin! It is so rich yet it's so lightweight. This is seriously the best preventative moisturizer on the market! And at the same time- it totally gets rid of fine lines/sun damage. I will keep purchasing this miracle moisturizer over and over again!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoy this moisturizer. It has claims to brighten, soften and plump/firm the skin due to the high strength vitamin c - specifically, claims to brighten the skin within seven days of use ( using morning and night), with firming and lifting after 4 weeks. I used this mainly as a night cream when I first recieved and noted the rich texture and how soft my skin felt the next day. When I started using consistently twice a day, I do feel like my skin tone evened out a bit. I'm thinking I need to use longer to see the firming effects - but overall I am happy with my results so far. My only word of caution is that it claims to be a good makeup primer, but I've found that it is somewhat prone to pilling if you aren't careful, try to apply makeup too soon after using, or if you use too much.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have oily skin and this seemed to brighten my skin at little bit, I think. I do not prefer the scent of this product though. I wish it was a little thinner too. It felt thick on, but that may be how it's supposed to feel.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wanted to love! It haven't skin a great glow and was lightly moisturizing, but started to come off in beads when I put my makeup on! Therefore only giving three stars

avis.titre: A new addition to my skin care routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was already using a basic brightening moisturizer that was good but didn't wow me or my skin so I was excited to try this product and brand. The little scoop is adorable and practical with helping lower bacteria in the product, the packaging is modern and attractive. The moisturizer is yellow and smells of like turmeric and I was hesitant about it possibly leaving behind a yellow tint however the product absorbs perfectly and leaves my face smooth and hydrated. As someone with sensitive skin, this product didn't cause any irritation or outbreaks. I've already noticed my skin looking healthier and brighter, so I think I will make the switch to this product and keep it in my skin care routine. The brand itself is also a highly reputable and ingredient conscious so that's also appreciated.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] What a wonderful product to trial. I was always scared to incorporate Vitamin C into my routine, but I was so grateful for this opportunity to and my skin has been responding well. Compared to other Vit C products I have tried, this one actually absorbs super quickly and well without leaving any tingly or itchy feelings on the skin. My breakouts have definitely died down faster and it just gives my skin an instant glow every evening.

avis.titre: New addition to my daily routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review][I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been this C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Moisturizer for a while now. I've seen a little change in my skin. The darker spots have improved. With continued use, the dark spots should lighten more. I didn't care for the aroma. I like that it has a little spatula to dip out the cream with. It blends into my skin great. There's no burning or irritation. It has vitamin C which is fantastic.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this but unfortunately had a bad reaction to it. The yellow color was a bit off-putting and the scent was pretty strong but I could get past both those things. However when I used this I felt a stinging sensation, which I thought maybe was normal? (Not sure if it is or isn't). But after a few uses I found that my skin which is usually really nice was dry and peeling in certain areas and I had to stop using. I do really like the packaging and that it comes with a special spatula to scoop the product out so you don't have to stick your hands in it. Sadly my skin did not agree with this.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Before on the left. After on the right. I would say my skin looked LESS bright after using this product. I normally use something I make myself with castor oil, essential oils, and other antioxidant rich ingredients. My blend keeps my skin looking great, this … not so much. Applies well. Not sticky. Not overly drying. Just not my favorite.
I absolutely love sunday Riley this was no different. It smelled like oranges and the feel is amazing. It did leave no residue or irritate my skin. I received this product for an honest review.

avis.titre: The Glow Stays Throughout the Day!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Thank you to Sunday Riley for gifting me the CEO Afterglow. Truth be told, I used this product after a couple of years and I had forgotten how luminous this makes your skin look. Powered by vitamin C and other extracts, this is a brightening moisturizer and the glow stays with you hours after application. There is fragrance, but the texture is smooth and absorbs into the skin very quickly. This does not pill under makeup and sunscreen either. So glad to be reunited with an old skincare fave!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ive used this product for close to a month. It makes my skin feel so nourished and healthy. Ibstruggled with flaky dry skin and it's fixed that. The packaging is so luxe and fancy. I would purchase with my own money

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice hydrating facial cream. The only downside is I don't really like how it smells. It smells a little bit weird, but other than that, it is definitely helped my skin even out its tone. Would recommend.

avis.titre: Super charge your skins natural radiance
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really loved this C.E.O. after glow brightening gel cream. I noticed my skin starting to look more youthful in appearance only using it for a week. It does have a citrus scent to it as well. When I applying it goes on smoothly. I did notice my face felt kind of greasy after using it for about a hour but, did not look greasy at all. I cleansed my face and apply this cream. It can be used morning and night and applied to the face and neck. I am on a weight loss journey and have some lose skin on my neck. I noticed the skin on my neck getting firmer so, that is a huge win to me! My face and neck felt moisturized and soft.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This cream feels amazing on my skin. The color is a bright yellow, and the scent is citrus, but also something just a tad bit bad. It smells pretty good overall, but a slight off-putting note in the scent. I love putting it on right after I wash my face, because my skin always feels super dry a that point. This cream goes on well and sinks in and leaves me feeling soft, moisturized, and sort of glowy. It does well with makeup over it and doesn't cause any issues with foundation or concealer sitting weirdly on your skin. Overall I'm super pleased with this product and will buy more when this pot is empty-though so far this is lasting me longer than expected, even with using it twice a day!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product. It helps a lot when my skin is dry and it applies very easily. I didn't breakout using it and it did seem to help with a few dark spots. I would definitely repurchase

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great hydrating moisturizer that plumps skin, helps minimize fine lines. It does brighten skin, gives it a nice healthy dewy look. It takes a minute to absorb, but is not greasy.. Makes layering makeup easy! Softness and hydration lasts all day. The only thing I did not like was the scent. It smells like some sort of plant, smells stale. Otherwise, great product! I received this product in exchange for my use and subsequent honest assessment and review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin cream is top notch. My skin loves it, and it feels so good. The packaging is nice, and there is a little product tool to use while applying it to the skin. The jar is pretty large and should last a while. I love how it absorbs into the skin. The scent is kind of citrusy. It isn't bad. This product does not irritate my skin. I would recommend this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Not a big fan of the smell. It isn't gross or anything just not my favorite. No irritation what so ever. Very think product that absorbs nicely and moisturizing. Creamy consistency that will occasionally cause pilling after face oil is applied.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have fallen in love with this product. I have been putting it on in the mornings after cleansing my face and I love the way it feel. It is lightweight and makes my skin feel soft and moisturized, and I especially love that is has vitamin c included in the ingredients to help with brightening. It absorbs well into my skin and doesn't feel sticky. I am looking forward to continuing to use this moisturizer!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive/acne prone skin and this did not help any current breakouts or prevent any, I would say I'm too sensitive to this. It applies nicely and absorbs well. I feel the yellow tint does give a type of subtle glow to your skin. It smells like crushed up dandelions, which doesn't smell great. The container is pretty however I feel like the applicator is just something extra taking up space. I would prefer if it could fit into the container somehow.
I do like how it brighten my skin. But sadly this product was not for me. I have cystic acne which I hadn't had it a while now but three days after using it, I started to get those cystic acne.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It has a velvety texture, but the smell is like fresh cut weeds. I wish it had a citrus smell to it. I'm not a fan of the scent. My skin seems a bit clearer and brighter than before. But I'm not sure I would replenish it when it's gone due to the smell, unless I see miraculous results.

This it first time trying a Sunday Riley product and I am so impressed. I now see what the hype is about. This absorbs like a dream into the skin and did not peel or flake after layered in my other skin products. It does have a scent but it didn't annoy or irritate me. The scent is leaning stronger thoe. Once I woke up my skin looked so dewy. I never had a gel texture vitamin c moisturizer. I be love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to receive a Sunday Riley product but this vitamin c moisturizer didn't work for my skin. I alway do a swatch test before trying a new product. I tried a little on my hand for 3 nights, and unfortunately it made my skin itch and turn red. I would be scared to apply this product to my face. This moisturizer has a heavy floral scent which usually doesn't bother me but this one smells too earthy for my liking.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It give nice smooth skin with a glow for my combo skin. The container is high-end with a glass jar and a appcater to get product from container to skin. I prefer a pump but happy there is appcater so my hand don't touch product in jar. It is ha nice citrus flower scent but it to strong.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited about this cream. I'm in my mid-40's, and feel like my skin texture isn't as smooth and bright as it used to be. I do also have some minor darker spots/small scars that I was hopeful the vitamin C might help fade a bit-the other active ingredients were ones I often hear recommended for all those things. The packaging was heavyweight and had a luxurious aesthetic, even including a little paddle to apply the cream. The cream was rich, but not greasy, and absorbed easily. I unfortunately did not see any significant changes in my skin, whether in appearance, feel, or texture, but I included both before and after photos, so you be the judge there!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this moisturizer! The formula is a turmeric colored yellow but it rubs into my skin seamlessly and leaves a subtle yet unmistakeable glow. Feels great on my skin and my skin looks and feels moisturized after application for the rest of the day. It comes with a little scoop / applicator which I love. Didn't cause any reactions on my sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the first time of me using Sunday Riley, and I would love to explore more this specific product. I feel that with consistency and time I will see more results, but for now what ive seen is that my skin feels very soft for long periods and very bright too but in a healthy not greasy way! Which I appreciate because my skin tends to be oily with the hours. It is very easy to apply and my skin absorb it fast too! I didnt notice weird reactions so I am excited to see the longer term effects!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin C moisturizer makes my skin look and feel amazing! I have to be careful with vitamin c products but this cream is top quality and doesn't irritate my skin at all! It hydrates and absorbs into your skin without feeling greasy. And the packaging and applicator makes it that much more luxurious!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The color of this moisturizer is very yellow and took a little more effort to get it to blend into my skin. The neroli scent isn't subtle at all! Thankfully the scent goes away after a while. I wish it was a bit more hydrating for my dry skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have a few Sunday Riley products but this is my first time trying this vitamin c moisturizer. It definitely has a citrus scent but also slightly herbal in a floral way. I like the cooling texture of it and love the little footed applicator. Sometimes you just don't want to use your hands to dig into the products. I think the consistency is nice and light however the color was a little more shocking and bright than I expected but that's part of the boost of antioxidants! I don't mind the feel of it on my face but I don't always like feeling a product on my skin. There's a thin layer that you can kind of feel. So far it feels okay on my combo skin and I haven't had any breakouts. My skin is dry in the evening after I shower and it absorbs well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This moisturizer feels so luxurious!! First off, I love the little spatula it comes with so you don't have to dip your fingers directly in the jar. I wasn't 100% sure about the smell at first, but it quickly grew on me! The scent is both floral and citrusy and feels very clean. It's thicker than my normal moisturizer (which is more of a gel), but this actually absorbs really well and leaves a glowy effect on your skin! I feel really radiant after applying it! I've been consistently using it day and night, and I can see my skin slowly brightening. Several of my dark spots have lightened, and some of my redness has gone down a little. Not completely, but it's definitely helping. I also really like that it's a makeup primer. I'm all for a 2-in-1 product! (It's quite expensive, but to me, that does help justify the price a bit.) I'm seriously considering switching to this moisturizer, but the steep cost is my main issue. If you can afford it, I definitely think it's worth it because you get a good amount of high-quality product!
